host-slot.description: One local Cubism session per version, including preparation on host and task-owned cleanup; different versions may run concurrently.

display-input.description: Private Xvfb display per job for X11 keyboard, mouse, window activation, or resize automation; no cross-job contention.

performance-host.description: Exclusive performance-sensitive host capacity for FPS, JFR, CPU/GPU, or latency evidence.

mcp.description: Production MCP HTTP discovery, guarded writes, restoration and task-owned normal close with a pinned stdlib client. FREE-fixture variant prepares task-local parameter bindings through the production SDK, verifies Undo/Redo and saved/reopened bindings, then restores the original model; it does not bypass native save restrictions.

atlas.description: Fixed single-invocation current-page layout timing+memory validation; circle/geometry 100/500/1000 across native/new/polygon on 5203/5302/5303.

backup-webdav.description: WebDAV backup end-to-end host validation: production webdav plugin uploads to the probe's recording WebDAV mock after a semantic SAVE.

backup-interactive.blockedReason: Interactive WebDAV sessions are not supported by the unattended local queue; no configuration is copied or host launched.

clipmask-viewer.description: Clip-mask viewer SDK and host validation.

dialog-automation.description: Host-dialog automation validation requiring an explicit fixture identity.
dialog-automation.blockedReason: The wrapper requires caller-supplied --fixture-remote and --fixture-sha256 runner arguments.

fps.description: FPS counting and render-driving validation; machine-exclusive performance evidence.

model-update-skip.description: Model-update unchanged-frame skip; repaint resize driver exercises off/probe/on legs; machine-exclusive performance evidence.

incremental-update.description: Per-object incremental model update; repaint resize driver exercises off/probe/on legs; machine-exclusive performance evidence.

protected-export.description: Protected-export export-settings hook validation for the reviewed 5.2.03, 5.3.02 and 5.3.03 editors: the contributed option must be visible in the native Embedded-Model Export Settings dialog and default-off, an unchecked confirmation must continue the native export path unchanged, a checked candidate must be rejected by the decision gate without a continuation window, and a cancel must reach the bridge cleanup without a continuation window. The copy-binding variant additionally proves the disposable-copy open/restore path before any mutation is admitted. The staged candidate plugin is not part of any release.

selection-brush.description: Selection Brush gestures, native selection, real input, lifecycle and invariant verification.

selection-lag.description: Selection latency evidence; machine-exclusive to keep thresholds meaningful.

startup-suppression.description: Splash, update-check, and information-dialog suppression validation.

update-check.description: Stable update-check request, comparison and rendered UI on an exact host.

edit.description: External-application edit session validation (session lock, cancel restore, commit, semantic edge cases, GetObject reads, fail-closed).

edit-protocol.description: Cubism 5.4-compat external edit API protocol bridge validation: a task-local stdlib WebSocket client replays the official 1.1.0 wire sequence (RegisterPlugin, token persistence, approval polling, EditBegin/End, S1-S6 matrix) against the host's own loopback service on port 22033, then a native 1.0.x regression stage; the probe plugin enables the external-app service, pre-seeds native token authorization and auto-answers the Turboism edit-approval dialog under a kill-switch file.

animation-timeline.description: Animation workspace SDK validation (enumeration, timeline, playback, scene ops, keyframe/easing writes, evaluated bake, native undo).

warp-deformer-alt-symmetry.description: Warp deformer Alt-symmetry reconnaissance: SDK Warp grid baseline, grid write/hook/native-Undo round-trip, optional calibrated Robot Alt-drag observation, and a human-in-the-loop native-ingress observation window on the reviewed 5.2.03/5.3.02/5.3.03 hosts.

boundingbox-warp-mirror.description: BoundingBox overlay whole-object Warp mirror: four-direction SDK applies with label/result verification, descendant canvas preservation, atomic Undo/Redo, NO_CHANGE, and fail-closed rejection on 5.3.03.

core-owned-moc.description: Production SDK owned-MOC structural reads, evaluation and ownership closure; separate from Editor persistence and full MCP.

texture-relations.description: Production SDK read-only coherent texture relation graph; shared/multiple inputs and PSD writes require further scenarios.

psd-export-observation.description: Native PSD export observation: readable-v2 or explicit save-only profile; issued handle and stop; no fidelity/replace/external-edit acceptance.

session-standard.description: One Cubism launch runs every read-only group-S probe in sequence via the session coordinator plugin; per-step results map back to their original task specs.

acp.description: ACP agent-window stdio MCP validation: the probe opens the Agent window via the action catalog, a scripted fake agent asserts the credential-free stdio attachment and performs one rename through the TurboismMcpBridge with guarded undo restoration, then the host closes normally.

official-viewer.description: Official Viewer observation without Turboism; private display and contained queue only.

official-core.description: Standalone official Core capture without Editor, Agent or plugins; immutable bundle and contained queue only.

model-import-3d-user-entry.description: Production 3D import menu, real file chooser, native dense bindings and Undo/Redo in a task-owned document.

model-import-3d.description: N2 task-new blank model, native ArtMesh/grid snapshot and Undo/Redo investigation; not full importer acceptance.

atlas-image.description: T036 minimal Circle100 atlas-image observation; no layout, sort, save, or performance measurement.
atlas-image.blockedReason: T036 minimal Circle100 atlas-image observation requires an explicitly reviewed bundle manifest before queue submission.

atlas-polygon.description: Atlas Dalsoo polygon packing E2E host validation: auto-layout write-back, undo/redo, save, and reopen state-hash verification.

bounding-box-overlay.description: Public-SDK bounding-box overlay contribution visibility, stability, clickability, and close detachment validation.

external-psd-edit.description: External PSD edit pipeline, reopen, GUI, and structural replacement validation probe.

external-psd-fixture-preparation.description: Official PSD new-model fixture preparation and mediated SAVE_AS validation probe.

float-array.description: Float-array parse cache optimization exact-host validation across off/on/shadow modes.

graal-script.description: Isolated GraalVM script runtime host validation.

image-archive.description: Image-archive reuse optimization exact-host validation across standard and atlas-workflow modes.

mesh-edit.description: Direct mesh edit mirror-axis validation across matrix and persistence modes.

plugin-management-chooser.description: Two-phase plugin management direct-JAR staging and restart verification.

resource.description: Native resource workload and memory observation across plain and profile modes.

semantic-history.description: Semantic-history baseline validation with history-panel and seed/manager probes.

semantic-history-native-ui.description: Operator-driven native Editor UI history ingress validation.
semantic-history-native-ui.blockedReason: Operator-driven native UI history ingress requires human desktop interaction unless explicitly automated.

settings-page.description: Settings dialog Performance tab and mesh-triangulation toggle round-trip validation.

texture-upload.description: Texture upload preparation optimization exact-host validation across off/on/shadow modes.

warp-position.description: Warp position projection optimization exact-host validation across off/on/shadow modes.

atlas-nesting.description: Independent bitmask nesting/BSSF validation with captured original contours, exact host matrices and per-side margins; fixed Geometry/Circle/heavy fixtures.

atlas-folders.description: Folder atlas production modal, hierarchy split, page dimensions, undo/redo, save and reopen on an isolated fixture.
